blocks.title: Debuggers
blocks.text: Debuggers are tools that help developers find and fix errors (bugs) in their code. They let developers test their code and identify where errors occur.

items: GDB: the GNU Debugger for C and C++.
Visual Studio Debugger: built into the Visual Studio IDE.

blocks.prompt: How does a debugger help find a bug?
blocks.explanation: It lets the developer run the program step by step and inspect variables, so the exact line where the program goes wrong can be found.

items: Debuggers: tools to find and fix bugs by testing code and locating errors; GDB, Visual Studio Debugger.
